info.title: Flint.NET spec-to-C# tool
info.description: Unofficial .NET tool for Flint (flint-chart): flint-cs to-csharp converts a Flint ChartAssemblyInput JSON document, such as one an AI agent drafted with flint-chart-mcp, into readable C# that builds the same document with the Graspea.Flint fluent builder or typed model. Install it at the version of the Graspea.Flint package it targets. It does not render charts. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: flint-cs is in preview; its options and output may change in any release.

options.name: --style
options.description: fluent (default): a chain over the generated builders; model: one ChartAssemblyInput initialiser.

options.name: --data
options.description:
inline (default): the rows are embedded; external: Build(JsonArray values), the rows are written
to <out stem>.data.json (needs --out); parameter: a Row record, a template and
Build(IEnumerable<Row>), BuildAsync, WriteAsync and Validate.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: A file-scoped namespace for the class (default: the global namespace).

options.name: --class
options.description: The class name (default: from the file name, such as RevenueChart for revenue.flint.json).

options.name: --out
options.description:
The output file, replaced atomically (default: standard output).
Exit codes: 0 C# written (catalog findings may have been printed), 1 input error, 2 usage error.
